name: pour
summary:
pour is an educational tool. It shows how the world in front of you can fail someone: the sign that cannot be read, the red and green that look the same, the button a shaking hand cannot hit.


Look at your own room, your own screen, your own product:

- Colour vision: red-green and blue-yellow deficiencies and full colour blindness, drawn on the headset's own passthrough so the room stays sharp.
- Sight loss: tunnel vision, central loss, half-field loss, cataract, double vision and more.
- Low vision: blur
